name: Tautulli
description: Monitoring and statistics for Plex Media Server. This build adds a German web interface (switchable under Settings > General) and takes its updates from this fork.

notes.text: Data (config.ini, tautulli.db, logs, backups) is stored in /config, the same layout as the linuxserver/tautulli Docker image, so its volume can be copied over 1:1.
Update in the web interface (Settings > Check for Updates) or with `update` in the container console.
